task: Read-only DF image and recording-path diagnosis; downstream 100 nm probe-focus convention and allocation-free padded-window planning.
execution_scope: No source or instrument configuration changes. No new full STEM scan or replacement image. This file records completed raw-array/mask checks, a synthetic vacuum Fresnel propagation, and memory-planner calls.

df_display.method: Read original float64 DF fraction from raw_scan.npz and the delivered PNG with Pillow; compare all 4096 encoded values exactly.
df_display.interpretation: Displayed dark valleys are nonzero low intensities enhanced by independent channel min-max contrast stretching. Their appearance alone is not evidence of missing electrons or invalid scattering.
df_display.display_orientation_note: The standalone PNG stores array row zero at the top. The comparison figure uses imshow(origin=lower), with row zero at minimum sample Y. This Y orientation difference does not create the dark-valley shapes.
df_display.display_source: scripts/generate_si110_cif_stem_scan.py:216-249; nearest-neighbour display, no spatial smoothing or image synthesis.

df_recording_path.profile: Archived acquisition_gpu_1024_final/operating_profile.toml, reloaded into default_state and evaluated with build_record_plane_plan.
df_recording_path.interpretation: The DF hardware ring samples a low-angle annulus inside the illumination disk. It is not an annulus excluding the direct-beam disk, so coherent and direct-beam contributions are expected within the implemented model. HAADF interception at high angles does not remove this low-angle DF interval.
df_recording_path.mask_method: Construct the 1024x1024 reciprocal grid at 40 angstrom FOV using the saved wavelength, convert each component by arcsin(lambda*f), and evaluate prepare_record_plane_detector_masks on the actual signed plan at the scan centre and all four +/-0.63 nm corners. The provider retains every physical stop and evaluates sample-position and affine terms.
df_recording_path.pupil_check_scope: A geometrical, zero-specimen uniform-pupil reference. Fractions are relative to the pupil population, not to source current, and are not a newly simulated specimen image.
df_recording_path.normalisation_review: Both CPU wave_fft.stem_diffraction_intensity and CUDA stem_cuda_pipeline divide by the full per-probe diffraction intensity sum, then integrate detector masks. No per-detector intensity normalisation was found. Finite reciprocal-bandwidth loss is separately diagnosed; the saved maximum relative propagation intensity change is 9.891211964672844e-05.
df_recording_path.finding: No specific detector ordering, scan-dependent DF mask, per-detector normalisation, or PNG encoding defect was identified that explains the dark-valley shape.

existing_limited_sampling_check.scope: Existing same-position 4x4 benchmark comparison, 512 versus 1024 wave pixels at fixed 40 angstrom FOV; not a fresh run or a full convergence proof.

underfocus_convention.geometric_definition: Probe focus 100 nm downstream of the specimen reference plane.
underfocus_convention.combination: C1_effective_nm = C1_additional_nm - ray_waist_offset_nm. An explicit probe_aberrations.c1_mm overrides sample.wave_defocus_nm as the additional term; lens excitation is already represented in the traced ray waist.

actual_sign_verification.fixture: Synthetic zero-potential 512x512 wave, 80 angstrom FOV, wavelength 0.0196874890068488 angstrom, uniform angular pupil 24.80467235853336 mrad. No specimen atoms or instrument changes.
actual_sign_verification.procedure: Form the probe using aberration_phase_rad with pure C1=-0.0001 mm and exp(-i*chi). Propagate through 1000 angstrom vacuum with the actual propagate_multislice NumPy CPU implementation. Compare the complex wave with the zero-C1 focus on the same pupil/grid.
actual_sign_verification.result: Negative C1 of -100 nm cancels +100 nm downstream Fresnel propagation to numerical precision.

window_planning.scope: Allocation-free calls to production plan_wave_sampling; estimates are not whole-application peak RAM or a guarantee of GPU allocation success.
window_planning.probe_support_estimate: r = max(1.22*lambda/alpha, abs(C1_effective)*tan(alpha)); at abs(C1)=100 nm the defocus radius is about 2.48 nm. A padding factor of 1.3 with a 1.20 nm scan-centre span requires approximately 7.65 nm, below an 8 nm FFT window.
window_planning.required_accuracy_validation: The 1.3 padding factor is a candidate, not a validated truncation-error bound. Compare central and extreme scan positions with 8/9/10 nm windows at fixed spatial sampling and common specimen/thermal configuration before a full scan.
window_planning.thermal_comparison_caution: atomistic.py:715-728 generates Gaussian displacements in the current atom-array order. Rebuilding different windows using the same seed need not produce the same displacement for overlapping atoms. Use a static-lattice comparison to isolate boundary error, or reuse one common largest-window frozen configuration with consistent cropping/position identity.
window_planning.sampling_caution: Increasing FOV at fixed spatial step preserves maximum represented scattering angle but changes angular quadrature spacing. The former 4 nm BF disk has only five mask pixels, so low-angle detector integration also merits a fixed-window reference comparison.
window_planning.image_expectation: An approximately 5 nm diameter defocused probe exceeds the 1.28 nm scan field. Clear separated atomic-column spots cannot be promised from this geometry.

model_limits: A physically possible coherent low-angle contrast pattern is not proof that the full calculation is experimentally accurate or converged.

The recording-plane router is a signed first-order map including position, affine deflection and physical sequential stops. first_order.py:269 explicitly disables spherical aberration in transfer tracing; it is not a full high-angle nonlinear ray transport.
The four-configuration frozen-phonon model and existing small grid comparison do not establish convergence with respect to all specimen, angular, window and thermal parameters.
Rutherford high-angle tail is an approximate complement outside the coherent wave grid; it contributes zero to this DF channel.
The diagnostic records and numerical wave-sign check do not claim a new underfocus STEM acquisition has completed.
